notes.title: Super Red-Hot Hero Lanch Livestream
notes.notes: Super Red-Hot Hero is a frenzied action-platformer, indie game inspired by Super Mario Bros., Super Meat Boy and Mega Man. Teleport through Red-Hot Energy at the speed of light, punching and shooting the TV robot forces of the Kazan Army in your path to save your island!

notes.title: Super Red-Hot Hero Launch Livestream
notes.notes:
Hello Red-Hot fans! We will be doing TWO livestreams during the Steam Winter Game Festival with the publisher and developer: February 3 4:30-8:30pm EST AND February 8 11:30am-6pm EST

Join our official [url=https://discord.gg/bpzmkuBX]Discord[/url]! notes.title: More Than 50% Achieved! We Show You A New Enemy And We Update The Demo!
notes.notes:
[h1]Thanks to your support we achieved 55% of our goal!! To thank you, we have some things to show you! [/h1]

We want to show you a new enemy we are working on. You can see it [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/strangelightgames/super-red-hot-hero/posts/1776502] here[/url]

We are also glad to tell you that we have updated the demo. Now you can customize the keys and we have fixed some bugs. You can download it from our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/strangelightgames/super-red-hot-hero]kickstarter page[/url]


Thank you all and happy new year!!

Bernardo - StrangeLight Games

notes.title: Kickstarter Creative and Super Creative-Hero Rewards
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!!! 

The first week of the kickstarter campaign went very well! Thank you very much for your interest and collaboration!!!

Today I will explain how the rewards "Creative Hero" and "Super Creative Hero" work.

If we reach the goal, we will send you a dedicated physical postcard like this:

[img]http://superredhothero.com/builds/imagessteam/4b46285042171961538d706570cdf846_original.jpg[/img]

Then, you will have to draw your design for the S-Tv face inside. Ok, we will send you two of them, in case you change your opinion about the first design :)

[img]http://superredhothero.com/builds/imagessteam/41e3bd1a228cd996b3bad7f765bf5ba4_original.jpg[/img]

When you have it, we will need you to scan it (or take a good quality photo) and send it to us by e-mail. We prepare it and use it on our S-Tvs!!

[img]http://superredhothero.com/builds/imagessteam/d8c6e0a6e6e6dc80baeed88a02bc84ab_original.jpg[/img]

Remember, we can only accept faces with black line and white background, to keep the style of the game :) 

Now, your S-Tv is ready to be destroyed by Super Red-Hot Hero!!! :)

[img]http://superredhothero.com/builds/imagessteam/0b26ca1cb397ceb7c0f41aebafab5ccc_original.jpg[/img]

notes.title: We have uploaded a Super Red-Hot Hero Demo to celebrate your support!
notes.notes:
[b]THANKS TO YOUR SUPPORT ON KICKSTARTER WE ARE NEAR 30% OF OUR GOAL!![/b]

To celebrate it, we have uploaded a [b]SUPER RED HOT HERO DEMO[/b] so you can try the game and tell us what you think about it!

Keep in mind that it is in development and it may have some bugs.

Are you able to achieve the speedruns??

We hope you enjoy it!!

You can download it from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/strangelightgames/super-red-hot-hero/posts/1763793] here[/url]
